title: FreeDNS for google cloud Nightscout down
body:
Seems today FreeDNS is down so I’m unable to access my Nightscout site.
While i appreciate this is not an issue of the xdrip team do you think there could be an option to import our privately owned domains?

To be honest the FreeDNS domains I find are regularly getting blocked so I would like to use a private domain but I’m not sure on the nginx setup manually.
Thanks

comments.body:
@mr-mjb Please don't open an issue.
Did you not see the note asking you not to open an issue?

I completely agree with what you are saying and the current setup is the best way to keep it simple for users.
For me personally, my domain server provides scripts for updating the IP so it could be managed but it’s the certificate management I could not work out.

> @mr-mjb Please don't open an issue.
> Did you not see the note asking you not to open an issue?

Sorry, i didn’t see the note.

This issues platform used to be cluttered with questions.  It was impractical to maintain the repository and figure out which issue needed to be given priority.

That's why we opened discussions: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions

We have respectfully asked users to help us by using discussions to ask any question they may have even if they think there is a bug.
If it turns out to be an issue, we will convert the discussion into an issue.
I just realised the mistake I made, should have been a discussion as I’ve done in the past.  Please accept my apologies!
